confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no live listings or booking pages checked. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are moderately confident. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to the draught beer anchor (about 4.4x and 3.2x) because direct knowledge is weaker. Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain given July peak-season variation. RMB was converted at an assumed rate of about 7.0 per USD. The FX value came from search-result snippets of the RBA page, not a live read, and was not independently re-confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is general mainland China tier-1 city price levels (similar to Shanghai and Guangzhou), with an upward adjustment for Beijing's July peak-season accommodation demand.
